kinds.doc: A sprite playing frame clips imported from Aseprite tags.

properties.doc: Imported sprite sheet carrying the named clips.
properties.name: frames

properties.doc: Clip to play. Empty means the first.
properties.name: animation

properties.doc: Advance frames on tick.
properties.name: playing

properties.doc: Restart at the end of the clip.
properties.name: looping

properties.doc: Frame showing now. Written by the engine as the clip plays, and read by the renderer to pick a slice of the sheet — the one-way path from simulation to presentation that invariant I7 asks for. Setting it by hand pins a frame until playback moves it.
properties.name: frame

properties.doc: Tint.
properties.name: modulate

properties.doc: Playback rate numerator. Integer ratio, not a float, because frame advance is gameplay and must land on the same tick everywhere.
properties.name: speed_numerator

properties.doc: Playback rate denominator.
properties.name: speed_denominator

properties.doc: Blend mode.
properties.name: blend

kinds.doc: A trigger volume. Reports overlaps and blocks nothing.

properties.doc: Which of the size, radius or points properties applies.
properties.name: shape

properties.doc: Full extents, for an AABB.
properties.name: size

properties.doc: Radius, for a circle.
properties.name: radius

properties.doc: Convex hull in local space, counter-clockwise, for a polygon.
properties.name: points

properties.doc: Bitmask of layers this body occupies.
properties.name: collision_layer

properties.doc: Bitmask of layers this body tests against.
properties.name: collision_mask

properties.doc: Report overlaps. A disabled area costs nothing in the broadphase.
properties.name: monitoring

properties.doc: Top-down is identity; isometric is a 2:1 shear applied at render time. The simulation is free-form 2D either way — this flag never reaches it.
properties.name: projection

properties.doc: Scale factor.
properties.name: zoom

properties.doc: Use this camera for rendering.
properties.name: current

properties.doc: Round the camera to whole pixels, for pixel-art projects.
properties.name: pixel_snap

properties.doc: Region the view is confined to. Unconstrained when absent.
properties.name: limits

kinds.doc: A solid body. Blocks movement and reports contacts.

properties.doc: Which of the size, radius or points properties applies.
properties.name: shape

properties.doc: Full extents, for an AABB.
properties.name: size

properties.doc: Radius, for a circle.
properties.name: radius

properties.doc: Convex hull in local space, counter-clockwise, for a polygon.
properties.name: points

properties.doc: Bitmask of layers this body occupies.
properties.name: collision_layer

properties.doc: Bitmask of layers this body tests against.
properties.name: collision_mask

properties.doc: Immovable. Static bodies go in the broadphase but are never swept.
properties.name: is_static

properties.doc: Blocks only motion opposing the local +Y axis.
properties.name: one_way

properties.doc: Receives the simple impulse response instead of only blocking.
properties.name: pushable

kinds.doc: An instance of another scene, with sparse property overrides. The source is named by the reserved `scene` key.
A run of text drawn from a baked font.

properties.doc: Font to draw with.
properties.name: font

properties.doc: What to draw. A newline starts a new line.
properties.name: text

properties.doc: Tint.
properties.name: modulate

properties.doc: Horizontal alignment of each line about the node origin.
properties.name: align

properties.doc: Draw offset from the node origin.
properties.name: offset

kinds.doc: A light contributing to the additive light buffer.

properties.doc: Light colour.
properties.name: color

properties.doc: Falloff radius.
properties.name: radius

properties.doc: Brightness multiplier.
properties.name: energy

properties.doc: Radial fills the radius; cone is limited to cone_angle.
properties.name: shape

properties.doc: Cone width, for a cone light.
properties.name: cone_angle

properties.doc: Cast shadows from nearby collider geometry.
properties.name: cast_shadows

kinds.doc: Bare node. Groups children and runs a script; has no presence in the world.
A node with a transform. The base for anything that exists somewhere.
A sound attached to a node. Presentation only — never hashed, never snapshotted.

properties.doc: Audio clip.
properties.name: stream

properties.doc: Mixer bus to route through.

properties.doc: Start on ready.
properties.name: autoplay

properties.doc: Repeat when finished.
properties.name: looping

properties.doc: Gain in decibels.
properties.name: volume_db

properties.doc: Random pitch spread per trigger, drawn from the presentation RNG stream so it can never perturb gameplay.

properties.doc: Texture to draw.

properties.doc: Mirror horizontally.

properties.name: flip_v

properties.doc: Blend mode. Also part of the batching key.
